title: Expand a bounded multivariate Faà di Bruno formula

source.citation: E. Di Nardo, G. Guarino, and D. Senato, A new algorithm for computing the multivariate Faà di Bruno's formula, arXiv:1012.6008

translation.notes: The Maple partition-table algorithm is specialized to multi-index (1,1), whose two partition shapes are expanded explicitly. The result is certified against direct exact differentiation of the composition.
